info.title: Shop Admin API
info.description: Endpoints used by the admin panel.

get.description: Catalogue numbers for every staff member. The system status (services, outbox, queues, search index) only for administrators; for other roles `system` is null. A service that is down, a broker whose management API does not answer (`queues` is null) or a search index that cannot be counted (`indexedProducts` is null, `inSync` is false) does not fail the request.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The database is unavailable, or the keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: The staff member identified by the access token of the `backoffice` realm, with any staff role.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: The whole category tree, for every staff member. Siblings at every level are sorted by name (Polish collation).

200.description: Root categories with their descendants. Every node has its `slug` (unique among its siblings) and `path` (the slugs from the root to the node joined with `/`, e.g. `turystyka/biwak/namioty`). An empty catalogue gives an empty array.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A page of products, drafts included, sorted by name, then by id. Every staff member may read it. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted. The category filter includes the subcategories and the products that have the category as an additional one; an unknown category gives 404. The search term is a literal part of the name, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A part of the product name, 2 to 100 characters.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only drafts or only published products.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the product list. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: The `category` filter names a category that does not exist (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.description: Creates a product as a draft (it is not in the store until it is published). Administrators and marketing only. The API gives the product and its new variants their ids and, for an empty `slug`, derives it from the name. A `variantId` in this body names no variant of the new product, so it is a 422. The product records the staff member of the token and the time of the change.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

409.description: The slug belongs to another product (`type` slug-taken).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: A field is invalid, a category or a variant does not exist, an original of an image is not stored, or no slug can be derived from the name (problem details with `violations`, each at the path of its field).

503.description: The image storage (Garage) is unavailable, or the keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail). Nothing was saved; the request can be repeated.

get.description: A product, also a draft, as the edit form needs it, with its `version`. Every staff member may read it.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: No such product, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

put.description: Replaces the whole data of the product (a form save). Administrators and marketing only. Send the `version` of the view the edit is based on: another current version is a 409 and nothing is overwritten. A successful save raises the version even when the data did not change. A row of `variants` with the `variantId` of the product keeps that variant, a row with `null` is a new one; a variant missing from the rows is removed. An empty `slug` derives it from the name, or keeps the slug once the product was published. The product records the staff member of the token and the time of the change.

200.description: The product as saved, with its new version.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

404.description: No such product, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The `type` names the cause: product-modified (the version is not the current one), slug-taken, slug-locked (the slug of a product that was published cannot change), product-not-publishable (the last image of a published product that had images cannot be removed), variant-locked (after the first publication an axis or the meaning of a variant cannot change), variant-in-use (a removed variant has stock or reservations).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: A field is invalid, a category or a variant does not exist, an original of an image is not stored, or no slug can be derived from the name (problem details with `violations`, each at the path of its field).

503.description: The image storage (Garage) is unavailable, or the keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail). Nothing was saved; the request can be repeated.

get.description: The tax classes a product can have, with Polish names for the product form. Every staff member may read them.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.description: Makes a draft visible in the store; a draft needs at least one image. The first publication fixes the slug for good. Administrators and marketing only. Send the `version` of the view the action is based on: another current version is a 409 even when the product is already published. Publishing a published product changes nothing (200, same version).

200.description: The product after the action, or unchanged (with the same version) when it already was in the wanted status.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

404.description: No such product, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The `type` names the cause: product-modified (the version is not the current one) or product-not-publishable (a draft without images).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The `version` is missing or not a positive integer (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Withdraw a product from the store
post.description: Turns a published product back into a draft: the store stops showing it. The slug stays fixed. Administrators and marketing only. Send the `version` of the view the action is based on: another current version is a 409 even when the product is already a draft. Withdrawing a draft changes nothing (200, same version).

200.description: The product after the action, or unchanged (with the same version) when it already was in the wanted status.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

404.description: No such product, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The `type` is product-modified: the version is not the current one.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The `version` is missing or not a positive integer (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Upload the original of a product image
post.description: Stores one image file in the image storage and answers with its key and a preview. Administrators and marketing only. One file per request, in the `file` field of a `multipart/form-data` body; send several files one after another. JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC are accepted, decided by the content and not by the name, up to 64 MB and 50 megapixels. The key follows the content, so the same file always gives the same key and is stored once. Name the key in `images[].key` of a product write; an original that no product names stays in the storage. The `detail` of a 422 is a Polish text for the staff member.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in marketing (problem details).

422.description: No file was sent, the file is too large, of an unsupported type, of unreadable dimensions or of too high a resolution (problem details with a Polish `detail`). The request is too large when its `Content-Length` is above `post_max_size` (70 MB) or the file above `upload_max_filesize` (64 MB).

503.description: The image storage (Garage) is unavailable, or the keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail). Nothing was stored; the upload can be repeated.

get.description: A page of products sorted by name, then by id, each with its variants in presentation order and the stock of each variant (null when it has no stock record). Every staff member may read it. The page size counts products, each with all its variants. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted. The category filter includes the subcategories and the products that have the category as an additional one; an unknown category gives 404. The search term is a literal part of the name, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A part of the product name, 2 to 100 characters.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the stock list. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: The `category` filter names a category that does not exist (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Correct the stock of a product variant
post.description: Sets the physical stock to the counted units, with a reason (a note is required for `other`). Administrators and the warehouse only. Send the `version` of the stock you saw (null for a variant without a stock record): a stock changed since then is a 409 and nothing is overwritten, so repeating a correction that succeeded is a 409 too. Counting what the stock has changes nothing: the version stays and no history entry is recorded. The history entry names the staff member of the token.

200.description: The stock as saved, or as it was when nothing changed.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in the warehouse (problem details).

404.description: No such variant, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The stock was changed since the given version, or created since the null version; or less was counted than is reserved, `detail` names the reserved units (problem details).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The count is out of range, the reason unknown, the note too long or missing for `other`, or a key is missing or of a wrong type (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Receive stock of a product variant
post.description: Adds delivered units to the physical stock. Administrators and the warehouse only. The `Idempotency-Key` identifies the receipt: sending it again with the same variant, quantity and note adds nothing and answers 200 with the current stock, so a receipt can be retried safely; the same key with other content or another variant is a 409. The history entry names the staff member of the token.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Key of the receipt, chosen by the client (e.g. a UUID made when the dialog opens): 1 to 100 characters, letters, digits, ".", "_", ":" or "-".

201.description: Received: the stock after the receipt.

200.description: The receipt was received before with this key and the same content: nothing changed, the current stock.

400.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or malformed (problem details with `violations`), or the body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is neither an administrator nor in the warehouse (problem details).

404.description: No such variant, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The key was used for a receipt with other content or of another variant (problem details).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The quantity or the note is out of range, a key is missing or of a wrong type (problem details with `violations`), or the physical stock would exceed 1 000 000 (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.summary: Stock history of a product variant
get.description: Every recorded change of the stock of a product variant (receipts, corrections, reservations, releases and commits), newest first, with the deltas, the stock right after the change, what made it and, for a change by staff, who. Every staff member may read it. A variant that exists but has no stock record has an empty history. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the history. Possibly an empty one.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or paging cursor (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: No such variant, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: A page of products sorted by name, then by id, each with its variants in presentation order and the price of each variant (null when it has none). Every staff member may read it. The page size counts products, each with all its variants. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted. The category filter includes the subcategories and the products that have the category as an additional one; an unknown category gives 404. The search term is a literal part of the name, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: after

put.summary: Change the price of a product variant
put.description: Sets the gross price of one variant; the API computes the net and the VAT at the current rate of the price's tax class (the class of the variant's product for a first price). Administrators only. Send the `version` of the price you saw (null for a variant without a price): a price changed since then is a 409 and nothing is overwritten. The same gross at the same rate changes nothing: the version stays and no history entry is recorded. The history entry names the staff member of the token.

200.description: The price as saved, or as it was when nothing changed.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

403.description: The staff member is not an administrator (problem details).

404.description: No such variant, or the id is not a UUID (problem details).

409.description: The price was changed since the given version, or created since the null version (problem details). Reload it.

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The gross is out of range or a key is missing or of a wrong type (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.summary: Price history of a product variant
get.description: Every recorded change of the price of a product variant, newest first, with the price as it was set, what made the change and, for a change by staff, who. Every staff member may read it. A variant that exists but never had a price has an empty history. Page with the opaque `next` cursor as `after`; the total is not counted.

parameters.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page of the history. Possibly an empty one.

detail.description: Present only for 4xx errors, never for 5xx.

violations.description: Present only for 400 (invalid query parameters) or 422 (invalid request body) caused by invalid input.

title.example: This is not a valid UUID.

ProductConflictProblem.description: A 409 of the product endpoints. `type` names the cause (the `detail` is Polish text for people and may change): the product changed since the given version, the slug belongs to another product, the slug is locked since the first publication, the product cannot be published (a draft without images) or lose its last image once published, an axis or the meaning of a variant cannot change after the first publication, or a removed variant has stock or reservations.

detail.description: Polish text for the staff member.

CreateProductRequest.description: The data of a new product. The product is a draft.

slug.description: Slug: lower-case letters without Polish diacritics, digits and single dashes. Empty: the API derives it from the name (or keeps it once the product was published). Changeable only until the first publication.

shortDescription.description: Short description, up to 500 characters; may be empty.

mainCategoryId.description: Id of the main category; an unknown category is a 422 at this field.

additionalCategoryIds.description: Ids of up to 10 additional categories, different from each other and from the main one.

taxClass.description: Code of the tax class, one of `GET /tax-classes`.

images.description: Up to 10 images in presentation order (the first one is the main one), each an original stored by `POST /product-images`; a key is used once.

variantAxes.description: Names of up to 2 variant axes, 1 to 30 characters, without a colon, different without regard to case.

variants.description: The variants in presentation order: one row per variant with one value per axis (1 to 40 characters); exactly one row without values for a product without axes. A row with the `variantId` of the product keeps that variant, a row with `null` is a new one. No two rows have the same values without regard to case and spaces at the ends.

UpdateProductRequest.description: The whole data of the product and the version it is based on.

version.description: The `version` of the product the edit is based on; another current version is a 409.

slug.description: Slug: lower-case letters without Polish diacritics, digits and single dashes. Empty: the API derives it from the name (or keeps it once the product was published). Changeable only until the first publication.

shortDescription.description: Short description, up to 500 characters; may be empty.

mainCategoryId.description: Id of the main category; an unknown category is a 422 at this field.

additionalCategoryIds.description: Ids of up to 10 additional categories, different from each other and from the main one.

taxClass.description: Code of the tax class, one of `GET /tax-classes`.

images.description: Up to 10 images in presentation order (the first one is the main one), each an original stored by `POST /product-images`; a key is used once.

variantAxes.description: Names of up to 2 variant axes, 1 to 30 characters, without a colon, different without regard to case.

variants.description: The variants in presentation order: one row per variant with one value per axis (1 to 40 characters); exactly one row without values for a product without axes. A row with the `variantId` of the product keeps that variant, a row with `null` is a new one. No two rows have the same values without regard to case and spaces at the ends.

PublicationRequest.description: The version of the product the action is based on.

version.description: The `version` of the product the action is based on; another current version is a 409.

CorrectStockRequest.description: The counted physical stock of a product variant, based on the version of the stock the staff member saw.

physical.description: Units counted on the shelf, from 0 to 1 000 000; not less than is reserved.

version.description: The `version` of the stock the correction is based on; null when the variant has no stock record.

reason.description: Why: inventory count, damage, loss or another reason (explained in the note).

note.description: A note, at most 500 characters once trimmed, without control characters other than tab and line breaks; required for the reason `other`, otherwise null or blank for none.

ReceiveStockRequest.description: Delivered units of a product variant.

quantity.description: Units received, from 1 to 100 000. The physical stock may not exceed 1 000 000.

note.description: A note, at most 500 characters once trimmed, without control characters other than tab and line breaks; null or blank for none.
note.example: Dostawa od Biegam sp. z o.o.

ChangePriceRequest.description: A new gross price, based on the version of the price the staff member saw.

gross.description: Gross price (VAT included) in grosze, from 1 (0,01 zł) to 99 999 999 (999 999,99 zł).

version.description: The `version` of the price the change is based on; null when the variant has no price yet.

DashboardServiceResponse.description: The state of one service of the stack.

latencyMs.description: How long the service took to answer, in milliseconds. Null when it is down.

pending.description: Events waiting to be relayed to the broker.

DashboardQueueResponse.description: A queue of the message broker.

consumers.description: Number of AMQP subscribers (basic.consume) of the queue, as reported by RabbitMQ. The Messenger worker polls with basic.get instead of subscribing, so this is 0 even while the worker runs: it says nothing about the worker.

DashboardSearchIndexResponse.description: The search index compared with the catalogue.

indexedProducts.description: Documents in the index. Null when the index cannot be counted.

inSync.description: Whether both numbers are equal. False when the index cannot be counted.

DashboardSystemResponse.description: The state of the system, for administrators.

services.description: Always in this order: postgres, redis, elasticsearch, rabbitmq, keycloak, garage, imgproxy, mailpit. A service that does not answer within 1 s is down.

queues.description: Queues of the broker. Null when its management API does not answer.

system.description: Null unless the staff member is an administrator.

StaffMeResponse.description: The staff member identified by the access token.

id.description: Staff member id, the `sub` of the token.

roles.description: Staff roles, without any other realm role.

ImageViewResponse.description: An image in the `thumbnail` size with signed URLs of its variants.

aspectRatio.description: Width to height of every variant.

variants.description: Signed URLs by output format (the file extension), widths ascending.

ProductListItemResponse.description: A row of the product list of the panel.

status.description: A draft is seen only in the panel.

variantCount.description: The number of variants (1 for a product without axes).

image.description: The main image in the `thumbnail` size; null for a product without images.

ProductListResponse.description: A page of the product list of the panel.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

ProductEditImageResponse.description: An image of a product in the edit view.

ProductEditVariantResponse.description: A variant of a product in the edit view.

values.description: One value per axis, in the order of the axes; empty for the default variant of a product without axes.

ProductEditViewResponse.description: A product as the edit form needs it, with the `version` a save is based on.

version.description: Version of the product: send it back with a save, a publication or a withdrawal.

firstPublishedAt.description: When the product was first published (RFC 3339); null while it never was.

slugLocked.description: The slug cannot change: the product was published at least once.

images.description: In presentation order; the first one is the main image.

TaxClassResponse.description: A tax class a product can have.

ImagePreviewResponse.description: A preview of an uploaded original: the `thumbnail` size with signed URLs of its variants.

aspectRatio.description: Width to height of every variant.

variants.description: Signed URLs by output format (the file extension), widths ascending.

ImageUploadResponse.description: A stored original: its key for the product form and a preview.

key.description: Key of the original (`originals/<sha256 of the content>.<extension of the detected type>`); the same file always gives the same key. Send it as `images[].key` of a product write.

ListedStockResponse.description: The stored stock of a product variant, in whole units; all computed by the API.

level.description: Availability level shown in the store.

version.description: Version of the stock, to send with a correction.

updatedAt.description: When the stock last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

StockListVariantResponse.description: A variant of a product with its stock.

label.description: The values of the variant joined by ", "; empty for the default variant of a product without variant axes.

stock.description: The stored stock, null when the variant has no stock record (nothing on the shelf, nothing reserved).

StockListItemResponse.description: A product with its variants and their stock.

variants.description: The variants of the product in presentation order; one variant with an empty label for a product without variant axes.

StockListResponse.description: A page of the stock list.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

StockStateResponse.description: The stock of a product variant after a receipt or a correction, in whole units; all computed by the API.

level.description: Availability level shown in the store.

version.description: Version of the stock, to send with a correction; null when the variant has no stock record.

updatedAt.description: When the stock last changed (RFC 3339, UTC); null when the variant has no stock record.

StockHistoryItemResponse.description: One recorded stock change: what changed and the stock right after it, in whole units.

type.description: What happened: a `receipt` of delivered units, a `correction` after counting, a `reservation`, the `release` of a reservation or its `commit` (the units leave the shelf).

physicalDelta.description: Change of the physical stock (negative when units left).

physicalAfter.description: Physical stock right after the change.

reservedAfter.description: Reserved stock right after the change.

reason.description: Reason of a `correction`, null for the other types.

note.description: Note of the staff member, if any.

reference.description: The key of the receipt or of the reservation, if any.

source.description: What made the change: `staff` (a staff member in the panel), `seed` (the demo data) or `system` (another module through the reservation port).

actorName.description: The staff member who made a `staff` change, null for the other sources.

StockHistoryResponse.description: A page of the stock history of a product variant, newest entry first.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

ListedPriceResponse.description: The stored price of a product variant. Amounts are in grosze, the rate in basis points; all computed by the API.

vat.description: VAT amount in grosze (gross minus net).

vatRate.description: The VAT rate the amounts were computed at, in basis points (2300 = 23%).

version.description: Version of the price, for the optimistic locking of changes.

vatRateOutdated.description: The stored rate is no longer the rate of the price's tax class: the price is not offered in the store until it is repaired.

PriceListVariantResponse.description: A variant of a product with its price.

label.description: The values of the variant joined by ", "; empty for the default variant of a product without variant axes.

price.description: The stored price, null when the variant has no price yet.

PriceListItemResponse.description: A product with its variants and their prices.

taxClass.description: The tax class of the product.

applicableVatRate.description: The VAT rate of the tax class today, in basis points (2300 = 23%).

variants.description: The variants of the product in presentation order; one variant with an empty label for a product without variant axes.

PriceListResponse.description: A page of the price list.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

PriceHistoryItemResponse.description: One recorded price change: the price as it was set. Amounts are in grosze, the rate in basis points; all computed by the API.

changedAt.description: When the price was changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the amounts.

vat.description: VAT amount in grosze (gross minus net).

vatRate.description: The VAT rate the amounts were computed at, in basis points (2300 = 23%).

taxClass.description: The tax class of the price at the time.

source.description: What made the change: `staff` (a staff member in the panel), `seed` (the demo data) or `tax_reconciliation` (a repair after a rate change).

actorName.description: The staff member who made a `staff` change, null for the other sources.

PriceHistoryResponse.description: A page of the price history of a product variant, newest change first.

next.description: Opaque cursor of the next page (send it as `after`), null on the last page.

backoffice.description: Access token issued by the `backoffice` realm (staff).
